rubric.description: Uses nested loops to traverse every row and column of grid
Correctly accesses grid[r][c] and accumulates the running sum
Uses nested loops to compute the sum of each row
Correctly resets and accumulates the running sum for the current row
Compares the current row's sum to the maximum found so far, updating both the max sum and the max row index when a larger sum is found
Uses a single loop from 0 to grid.length
Correctly accesses grid[i][i] for each i in the loop
